requirement.functional.name: ReachableByEmail
requirement.functional.@statement: A customer carries an email address we can write to.
requirement.functional.@counterexample: A customer with no way to reach them.

requirement.architectural.name: AuditedRows
requirement.architectural.@statement: Every audited row records when it was created.
requirement.architectural.@counterexample: An audited row with no creation time.
